name: Fischbachau (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, red and yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Fischbachau (a zigzag bar, a fish and a crown on blue with red and yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Fischbachau; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Fischbachau arms — zigzag bar, fish and crown
